info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Seafood Pendant Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Seafood Pendant Detail Management API allows businesses to add detailed information about seafood pendant products into the catalog. Through this API, users can submit essential attributes such as specifications, pricing, and descriptions, thus enhancing the product offering. This API is particularly useful for e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems seeking to maintain comprehensive product listings. Typically, product managers and developers utilize this endpoint to ensure that customers have access to accurately detailed product information.

post.summary: Create new details for seafood pendant.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details related to seafood pendants. It accepts a request body with the necessary information to successfully add details, ensuring that the seafood pendant's information is updated and stored in the database.
